canonical_definition: GQA is a benchmark for compositional visual question answering that evaluates real-world visual reasoning and language-image understanding capabilities in multimodal models. The task involves answering open-ended questions about images with compositional structure, requiring spatial and logical reasoning, and is commonly used to assess generalization in vision-language systems. Some papers note its application to identify language bias or domain-specific gaps in model performance.
